## How will Coritiba line up against Botafogo? See the team sheet

Coritiba, first of all, will make changes in defense to face Botafogo this Monday, 122, at 4 p.m. (Brasília time), at Couto Pereira Stadium in Curitiba, in the 30th round of Série A of the Brazilian Championship. [...] Coach Fernando Seabra is expected to field the following Coritiba lineup: Pedro Morisco; Fabricio Bustos, Tiago Cóser, Jacy and Felipe Jonatan; Thiago Santos, Sebastián Gómez and Josué Pesquera; Joaquín Lavega, Breno Lopes and Pedro Rocha.

### Coritiba looks to end winless run [...] Suspended after receiving his third yellow card, Bruno Melo is unavailable, while Jacy is doubtful after going off injured in the 4–0 defeat to Fluminense at the Maracanã. This leaves coach Fernando Seabra needing to adjust his defensive lineup.

Fluminense and Coritiba face off at 8:30 p.m. (Brasília time) this Thursday (8).

The match is part of the competition's 29th round.

## League standings 📊

The Tricolor currently sit fifth with 48 points. [...] Martinelli is in the starting XI after playing for Brazil.

Several players are one booking away from suspension ahead of next round's Fla-Flu derby: Ganso, Arana, Hulk, Martinelli, Otávio, Savarino, Castillo, Freytes and Samuel Xavier.

Fernando Seabra welcomes back Tinga and Jacy, who had been recovering from injuries.

Breno Lopes also returns after serving a suspension. [...] They boast the second-best away points percentage.

Coxa, meanwhile, are looking to bounce back after picking up just one point in their last three matches.
